drop-typescript-3: Agents don't install or keep TypeScript 3.x, so no realistic task hits the old behavior.
test-mock-reexports: Agent-written test code and imports are the same before and after; only install-time peer resolution changes, for projects pinned to @data-client/react 0.15.2 or older.
codemods-package: New package at its first release (minor takes it from 0.0.0 to 0.1.0); nothing existing changes behavior, so there is no old habit to fail on.
